## ✨ What's New

- Support OpenSpec 2.x, including detection of per-repository and machine-wide (global) skills
- Split Settings → Tools guidance into machine-wide setup and per-repository skills
- Show each project's update status on the Versions page, using `openspec update --dry-run`, including leftover 1.x files
- Support standalone OpenSpec installs, with an update command that matches how the CLI was installed
- Re-pin the tool reference to OpenSpec v2.1.1, with skill scope support
- Improve the add-project directory browser

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Parse delta specs the same way as OpenSpec 2.1.1, covering header spacing, closing `#` runs, fenced code, CRLF/BOM, frontmatter and section boundaries

## 🔧 Maintenance

- Add GitHub Actions CI on Ubuntu and Windows, with Windows smoke tests against npm and standalone OpenSpec installs
- Fix development scripts on Windows, and a test hang on Node 20
- Add an OpenSpec compatibility table to the README
- Update compatible dependencies to resolve known npm audit findings

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/oioi555/openspec-webui/compare/v1.5.0...v2.0.0
